ticket:
Build sumTo, the sum of 1 to n

src/sum.js holds a placeholder `sumTo(n)`. Build it: `sumTo(n)` returns the sum of the whole numbers from 1 to n: `sumTo(4)` is 10 and `sumTo(1)` is 1. n is always a number, a whole number from 1 to 1000, so `sumTo` needs no check of its input. Cover it in test/sum.test.js. Leave `sum` as it is.
